mapper.select: SELECT a.id AS assetId, a.project_id AS projectId, a.batch_id AS batchId, a.upload_id AS uploadId, a.entry_id AS entryId, a.file_name AS fileName, a.media_type AS mediaType, a.file_url AS fileUrl, a.width AS width, a.height AS height FROM label_asset a WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND a.upload_id = #{uploadId} ORDER BY a.id

SELECT a.id AS assetId, a.project_id AS projectId, a.batch_id AS batchId, a.upload_id AS uploadId, a.entry_id AS entryId, a.file_name AS fileName, a.media_type AS mediaType, a.file_url AS fileUrl, a.width AS width, a.height AS height FROM label_asset a WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND a.id = #{assetId}

SELECT p.id AS preAnnotationId, p.asset_id AS assetId, p.source AS source, p.source_file AS sourceFile, p.sample_token AS sampleToken, p.sensor_channel AS sensorChannel, p.box_count AS boxCount, p.status AS status, p.create_time AS createTime FROM label_pre_annotation p WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND p.asset_id = #{assetId} ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT o.object_key AS objectKey, o.object_type AS objectType, o.class_id AS classId, c.label_name AS className, c.color AS color, o.class_name AS sourceClassName, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(o.geometry_json, '$')) AS geometryJson, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(o.attr_json, '$')) AS attrJson, o.visibility AS visibility, o.track_token AS trackToken FROM label_pre_annotation p JOIN label_pre_annotation_object o ON o.pre_annotation_id = p.id AND o.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN label_class c ON c.id = o.class_id WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND p.asset_id = #{assetId} ORDER BY o.id

SELECT c.id AS classId, c.label_name AS className, c.color AS color, c.tool_type AS toolType FROM label_class_set cs JOIN label_class c ON c.class_set_id = cs.id AND c.deleted = 0 WHERE cs.project_id = #{projectId} AND cs.deleted = 0 ORDER BY c.sort_order, c.id
SELECT id FROM label_class_set WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
SELECT IFNULL(MAX(sort_order), 0) FROM label_class WHERE class_set_id = #{classSetId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE label_class SET tool_type = #{toolType}, updated_by = #{userId}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{classId} AND deleted = 0 AND (tool_type IS NULL OR tool_type = '')

UPDATE label_pre_annotation_object o JOIN label_pre_annotation p ON p.id = o.pre_annotation_id SET o.deleted = 1, o.updated_by = #{userId}, o.update_time = NOW() WHERE o.deleted = 0 AND p.asset_id = #{assetId}
